cards.summary_en: Multiple recent posts detail channel checks on SIVE, highlight ASP increases in lasers, price hikes, and potential gross margin expansion, with thanks for crowd-sourced updates indicating ongoing active research.
cards.why_now_en: Posts focus on current channel checks, pricing dynamics, and future quarter margin potential rather than just past performance.
cards.primary_evidence_excerpt: Think the most interesting update overall from Innolight channel checks was explicit confirmation that lasers across 70mW-200mW power range have seen ASP going up. Sivers also disclosed they raised prices. That should support gross margin expansion for laser suppliers in future quarters as higher pricing flows through.
